title: Pre-register on Universitaly
whatHappens: Since 2021, every international applicant must create a profile on Universitaly, the Ministry's official platform, select their course, and upload their academic documents. Each university reviews the file on its own and, if it approves, issues a formal eligibility summary.
whoDecides: The university, on its own timeline.
timing: Application windows are narrow and vary by university, generally between April and June.
whatCanGoWrong: Missing a university's specific deadline means waiting for the next intake — often a full year later.
whatKimereDoes: We track each university's window for you, prepare the file so nothing is missing, and submit it on time.
